Shipping & Delivery: Secure, Reliable, and Designed for Peace of Mind

At The Mobile Marvel, we understand that purchasing high‑value products is a significant investment. That’s why our shipping process is meticulously designed to ensure your order arrives safely, securely, and on time—every time.
Standard Shipping – $300 HKD (All Regions Except the EU)
Transit time: Up to 8 business days after dispatch.
We use premium carriers (DHL, FedEx, UPS) so costs are unavoidable but reflect speed, reliability, and security.
Express Shipping – $500 HKD (All Regions Except the EU)
Transit time: Typically 3–4 business days after dispatch (dispatch happens within 1-2 working days after order).
Handled by globally renowned companies such as DHL Express, FedEx International Priority, and UPS, known for transporting high‑value items with care and reliability.
EU Tax‑Included Shipping (6–12 Days, UPS) – $450 HKD (approximately €50)
Transit time: 6–12 business days after dispatch via UPS.
All import VAT and taxes are prepaid, so the price you see at checkout is final with no extra fees on delivery.
This service uses dual tracking: one tracking leg to our EU warehouse, and a second leg from the EU warehouse to your final destination.
Uncompromising Security & Assurance
Every shipment requires a signature upon delivery, ensuring your valuable purchase is handed directly to you or your authorized recipient.
Track your order at every stage with real‑time updates, providing full transparency and peace of mind from dispatch to delivery.
Your item is secured using robust, discreet packaging and tamper‑evident seals to protect against damage and unauthorized access during transit.
Customs, Import Fees, Tariffs and VAT/GST
United States, United Kingdom, Canada & Australia
For orders to the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia, your price at checkout is fully landed and tax‑inclusive.
The Mobile Marvel Limited covers all customs duties, import/brokerage fees, tariffs and any applicable VAT, sales tax or GST on your order in these countries.
These amounts are paid by us directly to our logistics partners and/or the relevant authorities on your behalf.
You will not be asked to pay any extra border or tax charges on delivery, as long as the address and order information you provide are correct.
In short: You pay only the checkout total; we cover everything else related to customs and taxes for the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.
European Union + EFTA
EU Tax‑Included Shipping (DDP – Duties & Taxes Paid)
All applicable VAT, customs duties and import fees are prepaid on your behalf.
The price you see at checkout is fully landed, and nothing further should be due on delivery.
This service uses dual tracking: one tracking leg to our EU warehouse, and a second leg from the EU warehouse to your final destination.
In the unlikely event that you are asked to pay any VAT or customs charges under this option, please contact us with proof of payment and we will reimburse you 100% of those charges.
Countries Not Mentioned Above (Rest of the World)
As part of our after‑sales service, The Mobile Marvel Limited will cover any sales taxes (not brokerage fees or storage fees) exceeding USD $50 on your behalf.
For very high‑value products such as computers and tri‑folds, we will cover any sales taxes exceeding USD $100.
To process such reimbursement, you will be required to provide proof of payment and a valid PayPal account for us to facilitate the refund.
We cannot return funds directly to your credit card, so please do not request this option.
We will not cover any customs duties if your country charges them (most countries do not charge customs duties on smartphones).
Where possible, we will declare a lower value to help you pay a smaller fee, within legal and carrier guidelines.
Non‑Delivery, Missed Deliveries & Refusals
To protect both our customers and our business, we apply clear rules around non‑delivery and delivery issues.
Responsibility for Correct Address
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address at checkout.
We are not liable for non‑delivery, delays, or loss resulting from an incorrect, incomplete, or unsecure address (for example, using a workplace, shared residence, or “leave at doorstep” note).
For security, all orders are shipped with a signature required upon delivery.

If a customer requests that the courier remove the signature requirement, authorise delivery without a signature, redirect the parcel, or otherwise change the delivery instructions after dispatch, they do so at their own risk. Mobile Marvel cannot be held responsible for any loss, theft, non-delivery, or dispute arising after such a request has been made.

By requesting or authorising these changes directly with the courier, the customer accepts full responsibility for the parcel once it is marked as delivered according to the amended delivery instructions.
When Tracking Shows “Delivered”
If the courier’s tracking and proof of delivery show the parcel as delivered to the address you provided, we will consider the order successfully fulfilled.
Any loss or theft after this point (e.g., from lobby, doorstep, reception, concierge) is treated as post‑delivery theft and is not covered by us.
You may need to raise this with local authorities and, where applicable, your building management or insurance provider.
Missed Deliveries, Refusals & Return Fees
If the courier makes delivery attempts to the correct address provided at checkout and no one is available or willing to accept the parcel, this may be treated as a failed delivery.
If the parcel is returned to us due to refusal of delivery or multiple unsuccessful delivery attempts (while the address provided is correct), the order will be treated as a return.

In such cases, a 10% handling fee will be deducted from your refund. You will also be responsible for both the original outbound shipping cost and the return shipping cost. If you contact us more than 10 days after the first failed delivery attempt, a 15% handling fee will apply to cover additional return and time-related costs and shipping as mentioned above.
If you wish to have the item reshipped after a failed delivery, additional shipping charges will apply and must be paid before we dispatch the parcel again.
Refunds will only be processed once the devices arrive back in Hong Kong with us.
Genuine Non‑Delivery (No Delivery Scan)
If your tracking does not show a successful delivery scan and you have not received your parcel, contact us within 3 days of the estimated delivery date.
We will open an investigation with the courier, and you may be asked to provide additional information or a signed non‑receipt declaration.

If the courier confirms the parcel is lost in transit before delivery, we will either resend your order at no additional cost, should you prefer to cancel at this stage we will charge a 5% gateway fee.
Our Commitment to You

We recognize the trust you place in us when ordering high‑value products. That’s why we partner only with the most reputable carriers, use industry‑best security protocols, and provide comprehensive insurance for every shipment. Our dedicated team is always available to answer your questions and provide support at every step.
If you have any questions or require special handling instructions, please contact us. Your peace of mind is our highest priority.
Global shipping costs are set to £29.99, this includes the UK, EU and the rest of the Countries we deliver to (with the exception of the USA, which is a flat rate of $59.99)
From the point where you order to the phone being in your hands can take between 5-8 business days. We always aim to have it with you ASAP but please remember, these phones ship from China/Hong Kong!
Shipping is provided by DHL Express, UPS and FedEx.
Accessories with reduced or free shipping, can take up to 12 business days.

U.S. customers please note, you must provide us with a FedEx account number upon ordering as it is a legal requirement for us to ship to your country. If you do not have one, you can create one for free within minutes at www.FedEx.com

While the majority of shipments receive no fees, we do our best to mitigate and remove all customs/VAT fees, this is not always possible in countries such as Greece, Hungary and Ireland. We will work with you on any fees we deem to be high, typically splitting the bill 50/50 or in some cases we cover it all!
Please do not hesitate to ask questions by contacting support, we want you to get your dream phone for the best price possible!
14 day return period on all electronic
Providing the device is unused and sealed, you may return the device within 14 days for a FULL refund.
If the device is opened and you change your mind, there is a 20% restocking fee applicable
All return shipping costs will be covered by you.
You can arrange the return by contacting support@averagedadofficial.com
USED SALES - Purchases being returned form our used section will have a 25% fee for returning unless there is a defect with the phone.

In short: With Global Priority, Mail Parcel and shipping from our EU warehouse, you pay no customs duty and no import VAT. We cover these import costs. There are no extra charges on delivery.
Last updated: October 2026
Do I have to pay customs duty or import VAT?
No, not with our shipping methods. TradingShenzhen or our logistics partner covers the import costs.
Shipping method Customs duty and import VAT for you Best for
Global Priority None, we cover the costs Smartphones, tablets, laptops. Delivery time 10–14 working days
Mail Parcel None, we cover the costs Accessories. Delivery time approx. 2–3 weeks
EU warehouse None, the goods are already in the EU Items in stock in our EU warehouse. Delivery time 2–5 working days
You can find the costs and delivery times of all shipping methods in our shipping regulations
How long does delivery with Global Priority take?
Expect about 12 to 19 working days from payment, roughly 2.5 to 4 weeks. The total time is made up of:
Processing: 2–5 working days. In this time we test and pack your device.
Shipping with Global Priority: 10–14 working days.
Customs clearance is included in this time.
What does "Clearance Delay" or "On Hold" mean?

This status means that customs is still checking your parcel. This is rare and no reason to worry. It does not cost you anything. If the status has not changed several days after the parcel arrived in your country, write to us via our contact form
. We will sort it out with the carrier.
Does this also apply outside Europe?
Yes, the same rules apply as in Europe. With Global Priority, we cover the import costs there too.
If customs charges do arise, send us the invoice via our contact form
. We will cover the costs and refund you.

TRANSPORTS DAMAGES AND LOSS

TradingShenzhen carefully checks the goods before each shipment and packs them carefully and without breakage. We ask every customer to carefully inspect the package before accepting it and to report any damage directly to the external postman. If you find that the goods are damaged after unpacking, we ask you to contact us immediately. We will discuss the further course with you.
In the case of a package, a damage must be recorded within 7 days. We would then send you an invoice for the actual value of the goods by e-mail.
Please indicate in the form that the package should be returned to us. As a rule, will be reimbursed after a processing period. We do not assume any guarantee of the amount paid, should not refund!
In an alternative transport provider the process differs at certain points and should be carried out in consultation with us.

If your package is lost, we will assume full responsibility and refund or make replacement. Before we make a refund or supply replacement goods, we will be entitled to submit an inquiry request. If this is not successful, you will receive a refund or a replacement delivery.

Should all delivery attempts to you be in vain, the package will be returned by mail. In this case, you are not entitled to a replacement, since we usually do not receive the devices back. If the device arrives with us again (duration up to 2 months), we will gladly send it to you again against reimbursement of the shipping costs.

The total weight of the package is transmitted to the customer with the dispatch mail. We ask each customer to check the total weight on receipt and should it differ strongly, it may be possible that products have been stolen from the package. In this case you should contact us
and, if necessary, arrange a damage to the shipping company.
For added security, we recommend opening the package in the presence of the postman, or a second person. If necessary, you can also make a video of the opening of the package.

TradingShenzhen supplies the goods EXW (Free Ex Works) in Shenzhen, China. The shipping service provider is liable for any damage to the product after delivery to the shipping service provider. In case of a damaged package, please contact us
and the shipping service provider.

About IOSS - One Stop Shop(European Union Region)
The Import One Stop Shop (IOSS) was introduced as part of the eCommerce Package. The IOSS changes how Value-Added Tax (VAT) on imported goods can be accounted for.

The IOSS allows a taxable person to register in a single Member State to declare, and pay, European Union (EU) import VAT. The IOSS can only apply to certain supplies. Where the IOSS is availed of, the import VAT due is not collected by Customs. The import VAT is, instead, remitted through a monthly IOSS return.
The IOSS can be used to declare, and pay, the import VAT due where:
the goods in question are located outside the EU at the time they are sold
the goods are dispatched in consignments of an intrinsic value not exceeding €150
the goods in question are not subject to excise duties.
The use of the IOSS by suppliers is not mandatory. However, the scheme does have a number of benefits for suppliers and consumers.

Where the IOSS is used, no import VAT will be collected by Customs at the point of importation. Consumers will, instead, pay the VAT due on the goods at the point of sale. Consumers will therefore avoid any further tax or customs charges upon delivery of the goods.

Q: Do I need to pay customs tax?

R: As customs rules in various countries can frequently change, this can cause delays, and at times additional charges imposed by the receiving country. While we take all reasonable steps to comply with general world shipping standards, Giztop may not know the details of additional customs taxes or duties, or if any specific item was prohibited or confiscated by the receiving country. It is recommended that you investigate the relevant local laws in your country. We declare the package at a lower price to help you avoid importing customs tax.

Q: When can I get the tracking number?

R: We understand your feeling about waiting for the package, we always try our best to provide prompt shipping to each order. Normally, we will ship orders 48 hours after you finished payment. The shipping company will return the tracking number to us in 2-3 days after collecting the package and deal with the package. So we will update the tracking number for you in 5 days. sometimes, the order status is processing, but in fact, the package is on the way, just a little delay on shipping status updating. Please wait for a few days patiently. You also can contact us if you have any questions.
Q: Why does my order’s processing time take so long?

R: When we receive a new order, our payment security team needs some time to review these transactions because of the large number of smartphone orders. After the review is completed, our logistics team can start processing the order and package it for delivery. So, our order processing time is about 1-3 days
Q: Why the tracking number updating is so slow?

R: Our warehouses are in China, Hong Kong, and Europe (only a few products), Our shipping process is much more complicated than your local online shopping, and it will take longer. When your package is delivered to the logistics company, the transportation has just begun. Your package departs from our company's warehouse to your hands and needs to go through China Customs, Hong Kong Customs, and destination customs. Each customs may inspect the package, and various customs procedures will delay the delivery of the package. During the period from the Chinese warehouse to the Hong Kong airport, the logistics take about 2-3 days. This is why your package cannot show that it has arrived at the website of express companies such as DHL. However, the package logistics information can be queried on the website we provide Arrived. Therefore, please rest assured that we will be responsible for the safe delivery of your package to your hands. Please wait patiently.
Q: Do you ship orders on weekends?
R: I’m sorry, our shipping team doesn’t work on weekends, your order place on weekend will be processed from Monday.
